title: 1:1 prep - Samira Patel & Olivia Hart 2026-05-02
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep notes and follow-ups
Date: 2026-05-02
Attendees: Samira Patel (CSM), Olivia Hart (AE)
Length: 30 min
Location: Zoom

Goal for this 1:1:
- Quick sync on top accounts (priority: Nimbus Corp, Brightline, CartaX)
- Align on open deals + next steps for technical enablement
- Surface any escalations/roadblocks where I need AE backup or SE time
- Career/cadence check (5 min)

Agenda (high level):
1) Wins + quick wins (5 min)
   - Nimbus Corp: demo follow-up went well; key stakeholder (VP Eng) asked for latency benchmarks vs incumbent. They want a 95th pctl < 150ms for short chats. Need SE to run benchmark on our dedicated config.
   - Brightline: success with embeddings pilot — usage up 22% WoW. Opportunity to pitch ded. capacity for predictable throughput.
2) Pipeline review (10 min)
   - JIRA-7891 (Nimbus PoC -> expand): next milestone = benchmark run + SOW sign-off. Oliv to confirm SE availability.
   - CONFLUENCE-2145 (Brightline onboarding notes): Olivia to propose pricing cadence for Dedicated in next call.
   - New lead: CartaX — interested in private deployment (compliance). Ask PM/Infra about timeline for Private GA features (KMS integrations timeline?).
3) Escalations & blockers (5 min)
   - Nimbus latency ask -> need a quick perf run. Action: request SE time, pick config, agree SLA target and test plan.
   - Brightline billing question: embedding cost spike flagged by customer — check Optimize recommendations and caching config.
4) Next steps & action items (5 min)
   - Confirm owners and deadlines, agree on comms cadence with customer.

Notes / prep for me (Samira):
- Nimbus: collect current logs/metrics (p95/p99, token counts). Pull sample chat workload (typical seq length ~180). Link to logs: slack thread CS-2246 with error traces.
- Brightline: prepare short case study bullets for ded. capacity ROI (tokens saved from KV caching + cost delta).
- CartaX: list security checklist questions and copy of Private deployment SKUs/pricing sheet.

Unresolved questions to ask Olivia:
- Can you confirm SE availability next week (May 6-8) for a 2-hour perf/benchmark slot for Nimbus?
- For Brightline, is GM ok with a 6-8 week timeline to migrate pilot to Dedicated?
- CartaX: who is the procurement contact and legal lead? Any pre-existing SOC2/HIPAA needs?

Action items (capture during 1:1):
- Oliv: Confirm SE slot for Nimbus perf run and reply on Slack by EOD 2026-05-03. (owner: Olivia Hart, due: 2026-05-03)
- Samira: Pull Nimbus p95/p99 metrics and example token profile; upload to Confluence page CONFLUENCE-2145 by 2026-05-03. (owner: Samira Patel, due: 2026-05-03)
- Oliv: Draft Dedicated pricing proposal for Brightline; share with me for review by 2026-05-06. (owner: Olivia Hart, due: 2026-05-06)
- Samira: Open billing review with Finance for Brightline embedding spike; create JIRA ticket and tag FinOps. (owner: Samira Patel, due: 2026-05-04)
- Samira + Oliv: Quick sync with PM/Infra re: Private KMS ETA; aim to have answer for CartaX by 2026-05-07. (owners: Samira Patel, Olivia Hart, due: 2026-05-07)

Personal notes / coaching topics (3–5 min):
- Check-in: workload balance — Oliv mentioned heavy calendar next quarter. Offer to shield some discovery calls to free up quota.
- Career: candidate for IC3 -> ask about interest in lead AE opportunities, training suggestions.

Follow-up cadence:
- Weekly 1:1 until critical PoCs close, then bump to biweekly.
- Use Slack thread (CS-2246) for async updates; consolidate customer-facing notes into CONFLUENCE-2145.

Quick templates to paste in customer emails during call:
- Benchmark scheduling email (short):
  "Hi <SE name>, can we confirm a 2-hour slot next week to run a dedicated perf benchmark for Nimbus Corp? Target: reproduce customer chat workload (avg seq 180) and capture 95th pctl latency. Samira/Olivia will coordinate test data and access."

- Pricing follow-up for Brightline (short):
  "Thanks for the pilot feedback — we can model Dedicated capacity to match your peak usage. Olivia will send a tailored pricing proposal by next Tuesday with estimated monthly cost and expected latency improvements."
